title: Bind evidence to the obligation
when: When attaching QA to a workflow transition or composing item-scoped versus run-wide release QA.
need: A requirement belongs to an item/task or a deployment run, optionally a stage and member. Item cases bind to their member and run with --item and --stage. Each attached post-deploy plan runs once per release as one plan group of memberless run rows, answering every item that attaches it; a pass credits the items attaching the plan when the group closed. A group failure blocks those items, while other plans and targets remain separate. Admission copies only item cases with executable methods; method-less standing rows stay on their item.
surface: Case attachment validation; Shipping Item QA/Run QA; QA subject reads
gap: Review question: should the first mixed release show a small explanation of item-versus-run QA, with detailed binding rules fetched by the agent?
